modals.title: Create Task
modals.description: Give the task a name, pick when it runs, and tell the agent exactly what to do.
notes: Create button disabled until Name AND Task/Prompt are both filled (Description optional) - no submit-then-error validation message, purely disabled-state gating.
Task/Prompt textbox auto-inserts a 'Goal / Context / Steps / Output' scaffold as real text on focus (not a placeholder) - undocumented in the app guide, flagged as drift not a bug.
Schedule combobox presets: 'Every morning at 9am', 'Every hour', 'Every weekday at 9am', 'Every Monday at 9am', 'Every day at noon', 'Every evening at 6pm', 'Every 30 minutes', 'Custom…'.

Selecting Custom reveals a picker: Frequency combobox (Every N minutes/Every N hours/Hourly/Daily/Weekly/Monthly), At-time hour+minute comboboxes, timezone display (observed: Asia/Dhaka), live human label + live cron expression preview.

'Advanced cron' button (inside Custom) swaps the picker for two raw text inputs: schedule label + cron/interval/one-shot expression (accepts 'cron', 'every Nm/h', 'at <ISO>'). 'Back to picker' returns to the structured picker.
Task complexity: two toggle-buttons, 'Simple' (default, 'Faster, lighter model') and 'Complex' ('Most capable model').

modals.title: Edit Task
modals.description: Give the task a name, pick when it runs, and tell the agent exactly what to do.
notes: Same field set as Create Task; pre-filled with the task's current values.

A stored cron that exactly matches a preset's cron string normalizes back to the preset dropdown value (e.g. '0 9 * * *' displays as 'Every morning at 9am', not as Custom) rather than staying in raw/custom mode.

modals.title: Delete <task name>?
modals.description: The scheduled task will stop running. This can't be undone.
